title: One source of the launch contract
description: One entry of `sources` of the launch contract (feature 107). The record schema `launch-contract.schema.json` of @specstride/contracts (generated by feature 100) leaves the entries open; this item schema joins to it by reference so that one composed schema is the validator (T005). The member names are those of the baseline (data-model.md, "Member names"). The members of `kind` are the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 256, read from @specstride/contracts (`kindsOfSourceOfALaunchContract`), never copied by hand. The rules a schema cannot state (the path inside the authorized roots, no duplicate path, no learning-decisions file, at least one source) run after it (research.md, row 14).

path.description: The path of the source inside the repository; inside the authorized roots (a post-schema rule)

kind.description: The kind of the source; the closed set of annex X §X.6 row 256 (kindsOfSourceOfALaunchContract of @specstride/contracts)

sha256.description: The content hash of the source (the canonical hasher of @specstride/kernel)

lines.description: The line count, read the way the baseline reads it (data-model.md, "Two readings taken from the baseline code"); 0 for a file that is not UTF-8

semantic_sha256.description: The hash that ignores the checkboxes of a task list; present for a source of kind `tasks`
